title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
why_read: A solid incremental improvement to automatic prompt optimization methods (building on GEPA) with clear benchmarks and shorter, faster prompts.
analysis: ESPO addresses the known 'prompt bloat' problem in evolutionary prompt optimizers by decomposing the process into diagnosis, diverse proposal generation, and stability-based selection, yielding measurable accuracy gains and shorter prompts across seven benchmarks and multiple models. The reported numbers (74.67% vs 70.91%, 47% shorter prompts) suggest genuine, reproducible improvement rather than marginal tuning. Relevant to practitioners building prompt-optimization pipelines, though it's an incremental advance within a fast-moving subfield.
